top_signals.title: Glencore Set for ASX Debut in Test of Mining Giant’s Allure
top_signals.summary: Glencore Plc begins trading on the Australian Securities Exchange on Wednesday after a listing that didn’t involve selling new shares or raising funds, in a test of the company’s ability to attract cash from a fresh pool of capital.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: OpenAI engineer arrested for allegedly planting spy device in office
top_signals.summary: A Saudi OpenAI engineer has been arrested for allegedly planting a hidden recording device in an executive conference room at the company's San Francisco offices to secretly record sensitive conversations. [...]
